# knowledge.KnowledgeSource

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

Adds a file or a web page to the organization knowledge base; indexing runs in the background.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `knowledge.KnowledgeSource` |
| Kind | `command` |
| PII | `none` |
| Tenancy scope | `organization` |
